CAS — 52-78-8. ATC — A14AA09. ATC Vet — QA14AA09. Adverse Effects and Precautions As for androgens and anabolic steroids in general (see Testoster- one, p.2130). As with other 17α-alkylated compounds, norethandrolone may produce hepatotoxicity and liver function should be monitored. It should probably be avoided in patients with impaired liver function, and certainly if this is severe. Uses and Administration Norethandrolone is an anabolic steroid with some androgenic properties (see Testosterone, p.2131). It is given in the treatment of aplastic anaemia in an oral dose of 0.25 to 2 mg/kg daily. Preparations Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Fr.: Nilevar.
